Universal Shaping Engine: reph/pref recording and post-base reordering.

Ports harfrust ot/shaper/use_.rs (HarfBuzz main, including the segment-begin linear-time guard and generic-base topographical handling). Syllables are found first with rphf and topographical masks tagged upfront; locl/ccmp/nukt/akhn, rphf, pref, and the seven basic features apply per syllable; reordering moves repha and pre-base marks; topographical and other features finish after clearing syllables.
